mods.name: Pokermon
mods.description: Pokémon jokers that evolve, Energy and Item cards, Tera types, Megas and shinies.
systems: Pokémon types on every joker, with Tera stickers that change a joker’s type
Evolution: jokers evolve by level (rounds held), by scaling, with evolution items or by deck make-up; an Everstone stops it
Energy cards energize a joker’s numbers (type-matched; Colorless gives half), up to a per-joker limit
Shiny edition (+1 booster slot in the shop while you own one) and Mega evolutions via the Megastone
Safari and Mega joker rarities; family-aware pools, a generation filter and a “Pokémon only” option
Items (Poké Balls, evolution stones, held items) as a consumable type, and the scry view (the top of your deck scores like held cards)

fixes.text: the Lua keeps ptypes / disabled on the shared prototype (self.config), so a goose disabled once (Chicot, Luchador) stayed disabled for every later goose until a restart. Per-fight state lives on the Blind instance here (blind.poke_ptypes, blind.disabled).
the Lua passes the text positionally ({localize(...), colour = ...}), so the status popup had no message.
the Lua shows the a_chips text ("+15 Chips") for this Mult bonus.
the owner wants these two Jirachi wishes live. (The 3.2.1 Wish Pack still never offers them: its "copy" wish is jirachi_invis, and fake_negging isn't in it.)
registered here; its Lua `stage` says "Basic", but it is Hisuian Qwilfish's evolution, so it is stage "One" (Everstone / pools).
create_random_poke_joker passed an undefined `pokearea` (a local of another function) to SMODS.create_card; the `area` argument is used now.
the Lua falls off the end (nil = not in the pool), so the Starter Tag could never appear; it is in the pool whenever every Starter Pack slot has a candidate.

mods.name: Nacho's Pokermon Dip
mods.description: More Pokémon for Pokermon (Sinnoh starters, Ralts, Bagon, Goomy, Terapagos...), the Stellar type and the Elite Four stake.
systems: More Pokémon lines built on Pokermon’s evolution / energy / type machinery
The Stellar type
The Elite Four stake
A per-evolution-line toggle for every line

fixes.text: the Lua's flat path compares an undefined global `_count` (a Lua error "attempt to compare nil with number" the first time a flat threshold is reached); the author meant the count it just took, exactly like Pokermon's deck_enhance_evo / deck_seal_evo.

SMODS only passes card_effects to the held-in-hand repetition pass, so on a PLAYED card the Lua indexed nil and errored (one reason the line shipped disabled); a played card always scores, so it counts as having an effect.
the Lua tests `edition.holographic`, a key no edition has (Holographic is `edition.holo`), so Holographic cards never counted.

the Lua tests `context.cardarea == G.hand or G.play` — always true, so the perma XMult also reached Pokermon's scry cards; the author meant played + held cards (as Goomy / Sliggoo and the card text say).

the Lua's add_to_deck / remove_from_deck read `context.card` — there is no `context` in those functions (a Lua error whenever Oranguru arrives or leaves while a Standard pack is open). They mean the open Standard booster (SMODS.OPENED_BOOSTER).

the Lua sets `card.ability.extra.ptype` unconditionally — an error when the received joker's `extra` is a number, e.g. a sold Banner; Passimian then simply keeps no type field.) The Lua writes the received card's blueprint_compat onto the SHARED Passimian center; Micatro does the same and restores it at every run start (reset_passimian_center) so runs stay independent.
the card text grants the slot only for a NON-Negative edition; the Lua also granted it for a Negative one.
the Lua reads `j.ability.extra.ptype` on every joker — a Lua error for base-game jokers whose `extra` is a number or absent; those simply get no typed Energy.

mods.name: Sonfive's Pokermon+
mods.by: Sonfive, with marcavis, Kek & MyDude (rebuilt for Micatro)
mods.description: Pokémon add-on: Nincada, Darkrai, Meltan, Garganacl and more, the Timer Ball, five new decks, negative Energy and the Lilac stake.
systems: Nine more Pokémon lines on Pokermon’s machinery
Negative Energy (the Void deck) and weather effects (sandstorm, hail, rain, sun)
The Timer Ball item, five decks, the Lilac stake and the Weakened sticker

fixes.text: None of the 18 jokers loaded as shipped: src/pokemon.lua required `sonfive_config.customJokers`, which config.lua never defines (its toggle is commented out in settings.lua). Jokers load; each line has its config.lua toggle as a mod option, all ON by default — Croagunk and Vullaby shipped off: Croagunk because it could never evolve (fixed, see 453_croagunk_line.js), Vullaby with no code reason (see 629_vullaby_line.js).

The per-line toggles were a global override of Pokermon's pokemon_in_pool, which every Pokémon's pool check (Pokermon's own, other add-ons') was routed through. They are a Pokermon POKE_POOL_RULES entry that only ever answers for this mod's own centers.
sandstorm() checked the nonexistent 'm_count' -> 'm_stone' (src/functions.js header).
Nacli was staged "One" -> "Basic" (src/pokemon/932_nacli_line.js).
energy_shift's j_marcpoke_toxtricity_amped branch (another mod's joker) is dropped.
(Manifest: missing Steamodded/Lovely deps, jokerdisplay/definitions9.lua never loaded — irrelevant natively; JokerDisplay isn't part of Micatro.)

Balls of Patience (src/challenges/000_balls_of_patience.lua) banned "tag_holographic", a tag Balatro doesn't have (its Holographic Tag is tag_holo), so the Holographic Tag still rolled in the challenge; it bans tag_holo. Its Buffoon-pack ban also listed p_buffoon_normal_3/_4, p_buffoon_jumbo_2 and p_buffoon_mega_2, which don't exist (every real Buffoon pack is already in the list); they are dropped.
Croagunk / Toxicroak logic, Lechonk/Oinkologne volatile flag, Darkrai on base jokers, Shiny deck weight stacking, negative Energy on base jokers, Oinkologne's sprite — each documented at its site.

sandstorm() checked the enhancement 'm_count', which doesn't exist (it was always false unless the hand was empty). The file shows a find-and-replace accident "Stone" -> "count": energy_shift's vanilla name list reads "count Joker", "Evercount", "Bloodcount" where the identical list in negative_energize reads "Stone Joker", "Everstone", "Bloodstone". In the games Sandstorm is the Rock-type weather, and its siblings map one enhancement each (hail = Glass, rain = Bonus, sunny = Mult). So sandstorm = every held card is a Stone Card ('m_stone'), and the three joker names are restored in energy_shift's list too.
energy_shift's `j_marcpoke_toxtricity_amped` bonus (a joker from another, unreleased mod) can never be present in Micatro: the branch is dropped (it always added 0 without that mod).

Negative Energy on a base-game joker (number / no `extra`) crashed in the Lua (`choice.ability.extra.energy_plus` indexes a number); the +1 limit is stored on `card.ability.energy_plus` there instead, and the limit check reads both.
negative energy *can_use* returned true/false where Pokermon's energy_can_use returns the joker (Bird Energy uses that joker); it returns the joker now.
'm_count' (nonexistent) -> 'm_stone' (see header).

it compared `consumeable.ability.key`, a field cards don't have (nil == nil, so EVERY consumable of any kind counted as "the same Tarot"), while its tooltip expects a {key, set} table. Now: only Tarot cards count; the same Tarot again = +1, a different Tarot = back to 1; previous_tarot is stored as {key, set} for the "(Previous Tarot: ...)" line.

"(Resets at end of Ante if no Tarot cards were used)": `reset` was set false on the first use and never set true again, so it never reset. Now each Boss Blind's end of round resets the count if no Tarot was used that Ante, and re-arms the check for the next Ante.

"If scoring hand contains Purple Seal cards, retrigger them and reset this Joker's retriggers to 0" — the reset happens only after a hand whose scoring cards include a Purple Seal (the stored retriggers were spent), not after every hand. Toxicroak, intended-design fixes: - it compared `consumeable.ability.key`, a field cards don't have (nil == nil, so EVERY consumable of any kind counted as "the same Tarot"), while its tooltip expects a {key, set} table. Now: only Tarot cards count; the same Tarot again = +1, a different Tarot = back to 1; previous_tarot is stored as {key, set} for the "(Previous Tarot: ...)" line. - "(Resets at end of Ante if no Tarot cards were used)": `reset` was set false on the first use and never set true again, so it never reset. Now each Boss Blind's end of round resets the count if no Tarot was used that Ante, and re-arms the check for the next Ante.

jokers whose `ability.extra` is a number (base-game jokers like Hiker) crashed the Lua (it indexed `extra.darkrai_applied` on a number), and a nil `extra` was replaced by {} which hid the joker's own mult/chips from energy_shift. The bookkeeping lives on `ability` for those jokers now and their `extra` is left alone.
remove_from_deck passed the lowercase Energy name ("colorless") as the type, so Colorless energy was taken back at full value instead of the half it was given at; the type is passed.

both are described as "Volatile Right" (and show Pokermon's poke_volatile_right tooltip) but only carried `volatile` inside config.extra; Pokermon's volatile rule reads the center's `volatile` flag, so other volatile jokers treated them as ordinary jokers. The centers carry `volatile: true` (set in index.js).

Nacli was declared stage "One" although it is the first of the three (Nacli -> Naclstack "One" -> Garganacl "Two"; it is also the only one with a shop rarity, 3 — the other two are Safari, evolution-only). As "One" a Poké Ball (Basic) could never give it, a Great Ball (stage One) could, and Naclstack had no previous stage to devolve to (Pokermon's get_previous_evo looks for a Basic). It is staged "Basic" (set in index.js).

mods.name: Risk of Jesters
mods.description: Risk of Rain-themed jokers, vouchers (3D/Mili-Tech Printers) and blinds, in a vanilla style.
systems: Risk of Rain jokers in a vanilla style
The Temporary sticker (a copied joker breaks at the end of the round)
Printers: bigger boosters (+1 card, +1 choice)
Boss blinds incl. two showdowns

fixes.text: Substandard Duplicator copied a joker every time it was UN-debuffed (Card:add_to_deck also runs with from_debuff when a debuff lifts — The Loop, Crimson Heart): only real gains count.
Happiest Mask rolled whenever a joker was DEBUFFED (Card:remove_from_deck(from_debuff)): only cards actually leaving the game (Card:remove) count as destroyed.

The Void's end-of-round wrap RETURNED instead of calling the joker's own calculation, so on The Void no joker's end-of-round effect ran (Mr. Bones couldn't save you; Benthic Bloom and Encrusted Key never fired on this Boss Blind). Jokers act normally; afterwards every joker's sell value is set to 0 — as a sell value (extra_value), so a later set_cost (Gift Card, Egg, an edition) can't silently restore the old price the way the Lua's bare sell_cost = 0 could.
Snake Eyes scaled once more for each Blueprint/Brainstorm copying it (its wheel_failed branch has no `not context.blueprint`, unlike the mod's other scaling jokers): copies don't scale it.

Encrusted Key (blueprint_compat) gave Blueprint (copying from the left) nothing — Blueprint destroyed the Key first — but gave Brainstorm a second tag and a second removal. A copy now always gives one extra Coupon Tag; only the Key's own trigger destroys it.
Glaucous Hammer's `hammered` marks were never cleared, so a second Glaucous Hammer (endless) debuffed its new random half PLUS the old one: each fight marks a fresh half.

mods.name: Sylvie's Silliness
mods.description: Decks, blinds, themed packs, moon planets that buff a suit, and the Bloom spectral.
systems: Moons: Planet cards that give every card of a suit +5 Chips, or buff an enhancement for the rest of the run
Themed booster packs (Suits, Bonus, Fortune)
Seal vouchers for Standard packs, four decks and six bosses

fixes.text: Sulfur Deck's "Jokers appear less often" did nothing: its joker_rate = 4 was read by neither the base game nor the mod's apply_to_run wrap. The shop's joker rate is 4 (from 20).

Charon and Titan ("Affects Current and Future cards") never reached CURRENT Bonus / Stone cards: set_ability subtracts the OLD center's bonus — the same, already-raised table — so the card kept its old chips (and a card later re-enhanced away went negative). Current cards gain the bonus too (also shop / pack cards, so every card's bookkeeping stays right).

The moon upgrades lived in the global G.P_CENTERS tables, reset only by Game:start_run — a continued (saved) run silently lost them for future cards. They are per-run state (G.GAME.sylvie_enh), saved with the run, and never leak into another run.
Europa / Io / Callisto / Ganymede skipped debuffed cards of their suit (is_suit without bypass_debuff — e.g. Io during The Club upgraded no Clubs): every card of the suit counts.
Aurora Deck only gave unenhanced playing cards ('Default') an edition; Enhanced cards from the same Standard pack never did. "Playing Cards are usually Special": both do.
Bloom picked its tag with an unseeded pseudorandom_element (math.random): seeded ('bloom'), so runs replay.

Hallowed Deck's "Playing Cards now appear in the shop" rate (10) was overwritten by its own Magic Trick voucher, whose apply_to_run sets the rate (4) in a QUEUED event that runs after the deck's wrap: the shop's playing-card rate is 10, as the deck sets it.

mods.name: Milatro
systems: 30 jokers (no new systems)

fixes.text: Colorblindness: the Lua test `(self is Club/Diamond) == (suit is Club/Diamond)` also made Spades and Hearts one suit (a Spade answered is_suit('Hearts')). Its text — and the Smeared combo, where everything merges — say only Clubs and Diamonds count as the same suit.

The Reaper / Magic Hat set G.GAME.consumeable_buffer to the NUMBER of held consumables (and Magic Hat never reset it), which starved every vanilla consumable creator (Seance, 8 Ball, Cartomancer, Purple/Blue seals...) for the rest of the run. They use Balatro's own room check (#cards + buffer < limit, buffer reset when the card lands).
How Hungry: `contains7` was never cleared, so after ONE hand with a scoring 7 every later scoring 9 was eaten. It is re-evaluated each hand ("If hand contains both ... 7 and 9").
Hole in One checked every PLAYED card for the Ace; the text (and name) say a SCORING Ace.
How Hungry kept card objects in ability.extra (not serialisable here): it keeps sort ids.

mods.name: Mika's Mod Collection
mods.description: 60 jokers, 7 decks, and new Tarot/Spectral cards; playing cards can gain permanent Mult.
systems: Permanent Mult on playing cards (shown on the card)
60 jokers, 7 decks and a few Tarots / a Spectral, each with its own toggle

fixes.text: blueprint_compat = false jokers without a `not context.blueprint` guard (Fisherman, Eye Chart, Finishing Blow, Printer, Commander, Harp Seal, Stockpiler, One Of Us, Shackles, Pack A Punch, Seal Steal, Scoring Test, Plus One, Cicero, Dagonet) were still copied by Blueprint/Brainstorm (vanilla Blueprint copies any joker; only the guard stops it): they now ignore copies.
Harp Seal paid a Gold Seal card's bonus twice (ease_dollars(3) AND `dollars = 3`, which evaluate_play pays again: +$6, tripling the seal) — "Doubles the effect": +$3.
Grudgeful Joker's total_chips was never reset, so after round 1 the "excess" was every chip ever scored (always the 25% cap) — it resets each round like Show-Off / Sniper.

Dagonet's blacklist was an array indexed by name (`blacklist[name] == nil` is always true), so it doubled Credit Card / Juggler / Turtle Bean / Drunkard / Troubadour / Merry Andy and broke their add/remove bookkeeping — the six are skipped as listed.
Student Loans, back in the black, gave back only 1 discard however many it had taken (ease_discard(1)) — it returns all of them.
Finishing Blow kept the scored cards of EVERY High Card hand of the round (card_refs only cleared at round end) and enhanced them all — only the finishing hand's cards are enhanced.
Scoring Test recorded the hand at joker_main, which a debuffed hand skips, then destroyed the PREVIOUS hand's cards (wherever they were) — it records debuffed hands too.
Fishing License returned `Xmult` for Glass cards (evaluate_play reads `x_mult` per card), so Glass did nothing — it copies the X2.
The Commander checked `card.ability.seal` (always nil; seals live in card.seal), so it replaced existing seals — like the edition/enhancement it only adds one when there is none.
Glue: a second Half Joker / Incomplete Joker granted Glue's +2 slots again (and removing one of two took them away while the other remained) — +2 slots while both are owned, once.

Perma-mult (Mountain Climber): the lovely override of Card:get_chip_mult returned mult + perma_mult before the debuff and Lucky checks, so debuffed cards still scored Mult and Lucky cards always paid their +20 — the engine's perma_mult adds to the vanilla rules (shown as "+N extra Mult"; a Mult Card shows its total as the lovely patch does).

mods.name: Olympus
systems: Jokers of the Greek gods (no new systems)

fixes.text: Artemis / Apollo checked for a free consumable slot but never reserved it (G.GAME.consumeable_buffer was only reset, never incremented — Cartomancer increments it), so Artemis + Apollo with one free slot both passed the check and overfilled the slots. They reserve the slot like Cartomancer.

Hades told the jokers `remove_playing_cards` with `removed = <the card>` — a single card where every listener iterates a LIST (Glass Joker, Caino, mod jokers), so nothing ever saw the destroyed card. It passes `removed = [card]`.

Hades destroys a card once: a retriggered card (Red Seal) or a Blueprint copy still pays $3 per trigger as in the Lua, but the card is dissolved — and remove_playing_cards announced — once (the Lua dissolved it and told every joker again per trigger).

mods.name: Inscrybed Jokers
systems: Inscryption-themed jokers (no new systems)

fixes.text: Every scoring branch tested `context.end_calculate_context == G.jokers` — a field no context has (Steamodded's helper is the FUNCTION SMODS.end_calculate_context(context)), so no joker ever added its Chips/Mult. They score in the main joker pass (joker_main).

Deathly listened for `context.cards_removed` (no such context; the game's is remove_playing_cards with `removed`) and called `v.getID()` (crash: it's v:get_id()). It grows on remove_playing_cards (and cards_destroyed / glass_shattered) by 2 x rank (get_id: J 11, Q 12, K 13, A 14), and only shows "Upgrade!" when a card was destroyed.

Techno reset to `extra.base_mult`, which config never defines (nil -> the next hand crashed on nil + 8). It resets to its starting +8 Mult (the reset message says +8), once at end of round (not again per held card / repetition pass).
Magickal added `self.ability.mult_mod` (nil -> crash); the config value is extra.mult_mod (+3).
Upgrade popups: `localize{'k_upgrade_ex'}` (a malformed call -> "ERROR") is localize('k_upgrade_ex'); a_chips got a bare number for vars -> [n].

Blueprint / Brainstorm copy the Chips/Mult but don't scale the original a second time (the Lua scaled `self` — the copied joker — on every copy; vanilla scaling jokers all guard with `not context.blueprint`). Beastly's destroy-on-discard is the original's alone.

fixes.text: The Lua created the Tarot with no room check, so it overflowed the consumable slots (and zeroed G.GAME.consumeable_buffer under any other pending creator). Its code is Vagabond's Tarot creation, which only creates when #consumeables + buffer < limit: that check is back.

mods.description: A deck with extra joker slots and extra Negative jokers.
systems: One deck: extra joker slots and extra Negative jokers

fixes.text: The deck art: the Lua registered its Enhancers.png AS the game's "centers" atlas, which replaced the art of every enhancement, deck back, voucher-less center in the whole game just to give this deck its cell {5,5}. Here the sheet is the deck's own atlas (omertadeck_enhancers) and vanilla art is untouched.

mods.name: More Fluff
mods.by: notmario and contributors (1.9.9999, rebuilt for Micatro)
mods.description: 69 jokers, Colour cards that charge up over rounds, Rotarot cards, new enhancements and decks, six harder stakes, and DX Superboss blinds you pick at the winning ante.
systems: Version 1.9.9999 (the rewrite): this port has its 69 returning jokers; its new ones follow in later batches
Colour cards: a consumable type that charges up one round at a time and grows stronger the longer you hold it
45° Rotated Tarots (Rotarots): a second tarot-like type, with the Rotarot Merchant / Tycoon vouchers
Eight new enhancements; the Token rarity and the hidden "Old Fluff" rarity of retired jokers
Six stakes above Gold with the Heavy, Potato and Suspended stickers, and an exile zone for suspended cards
Superboss mode: at the winning ante The Ticket lets you pick a DX boss (Final Stake: all three blinds)
The Purple Deck and its own music

fixes.text: every base-game joker is left out (the 1.5.6 Lua's hard-coded vanilla lists missed j_jolly; 1.9.9999's filter is center.original_mod, the same as this).

(fixed upstream too in 1.9.9999) Fast-Growing Sapling: selling it called G.GAME.blind:defeat() itself before the round ended, so the blind was already cleared when end_round ran — on a Boss Blind the ante never advanced (a boss beaten with TREE(3) could never win the run at ante 8), the blind paid no reward, and a disable/defeat effect ran twice (The Manacle gave its hand size back twice). The round now ends normally with the score set to the blind's ("set round score to TREE(3)"): end_round/evaluate_round defeat the blind once.

Joke Merge Valley destroyed the merged cards with an instant start_dissolve while they were still being discarded; here (instant dissolves) the discard then drew the removed cards into the discard pile as zombies. They dissolve once the discard has moved them (as the Lua animation does).
Missing Joker kept its transformed cards in a global (G.missingjoker_revert): it is per run state (G.GAME.mf_missingjoker_revert, sort ids) so a save / replay turns them back too.
Less Fluff's "X#1#" popup used the variable key 'x_mult' (not a key: no text); it uses a_xmult (1.9.9999 too).

the Lua tested G.STATE, which is always PLAY_TAROT once G.FUNCS.use_card runs, so its "outside a round -> into the deck" branch (BLIND_SELECT / ROUND_EVAL) never fired and the cards landed in the (absent) hand. The state the card was used FROM decides here.

the Lua's hook-discard (G.FUNCS.discard_cards_from_highlighted(nil, true)) never draws again, so House DX / Hook DX left an EMPTY hand and the round could not go on. The hand is redrawn after the discard (the mod's own test house_dx_discards expects the deck drawn through).

mods.name: Betmma Vouchers
mods.description: 58 new vouchers and 24 fusion vouchers (with voucher rarities), voucher packs, 11 jokers, 2 editions and 5 challenges.
systems: 58 vouchers plus 24 fusion vouchers (two vouchers merged into one)
Voucher rarity: rarer vouchers roll less often
Voucher packs (normal, uncommon, fusion)
The Phantom and Tentacle editions; the Real Random voucher
A toggle per voucher and five challenges

fixes.text: phantom.lua's sell wrap never checks for the voucher, so every Phantom joker reincarnated when sold, with or without Reincarnate. Only Reincarnate does that.
Reincarnate: phantom.lua's Card:sell_card wrap never checked for the voucher, so selling ANY Phantom joker made a new joker; only with Reincarnate now (editions.js).
Overkill's `rarity=2` sat beside its config (where get_rarity never looks), so it was common; it's uncommon (vouchers.js).
The voucher rarity switch (enable_voucher_rarity) only turned the fusion weights off; it now turns the rarity roll off too (vouchers.js voucher_pool_filter).
Real Random zeroed the Lucky Card's own Mult but forgot its 1 in 15 $20 (and the hidden rolls still counted as lucky triggers): the card's own effects are fully replaced (real_random.js).
Real Random's "random Negative Joker" ability created times² jokers when it fired `times` times (nested loop); `times` jokers now (real_random.js).
Scrawl / Reincarnate could push joker_buffer negative for the rest of the run when the joker row was over-full (min(1, slots left) < 0), breaking later "must have room" checks; clamped at 0.
Engine fix (task): buying an EXTRA shop voucher (SMODS voucher slots) cleared the round's main voucher — Card:redeem nulled current_round.voucher for every voucher (consumables.js).
the Lua zeroes the Lucky Card's own Mult under Real Random but forgot its 1 in 15 $20, which kept paying although the card's text now lists only its random abilities.
the Lua puts `rarity=2` beside config (SMODS.Voucher{..., rarity=2}), where get_rarity never looks, so Overkill was silently common. It's meant to be uncommon like its tier.
the config switch is called enable_voucher_rarity, but the shipped code only used it to turn the fusion weights off; it now switches the rarity roll off too (default: on).

mods.notPorted: Not ported as code: Better_Vouchers_This_Run_UI (Micatro's Run Info voucher list scrolls instead), Cryptid.lua (optional Cryptid compat), jokerdisplay_integration.lua, and lovely/ability.toml + lovely/spell.toml — orphans patching Betmma Abilities / Betmma Spells, which aren't in the bundle. Balatro Mobile's "ability area" mode belongs to Betmma Abilities too, so it isn't there either.

options.label: Voucher rarity (Uncommon 1/2, Rare 1/4, Legendary 1/20; fusions weigh 4)

mods.name: Bunco
mods.by: Firch, RENREN, Peas, minichibis, J.D., Guwahavel, Ciirulean & ejwu (rebuilt for Micatro)
mods.description: 80 jokers, two exotic suits (Fleurons, Halberds), Spectrum hands, Polymino cards that link cards together, Blind and Virtual packs, 25 blinds, 16 tags and more.
systems: Exotic suits — Fleurons and Halberds — and five Spectrum poker hands
Polymino cards that LINK playing cards (linked cards are selected, drawn and destroyed together)
Blind packs (choose this ante’s boss) and Virtual packs (the whole deck, Polyminoes used at once)
New stakes with the Scattering, Hindered and Reactive stickers
The Glitter and Fluorescent editions, Cracker and Copper cards
Optional gameplay reworks of some vanilla cards

fixes.text: Sledgehammer: add / remove count SMODS.find_card('j_bunc_sledgehammer') to apply Glass's 1 in 4 -> 1 in 1 only for the first / last one. A debuff (Card:set_debuff calls remove_from_deck(true) while the card is still in G.jokers and not yet debuffed) counts the card itself, so the chance is not restored; the un-debuff (add_to_deck(true) while still debuffed) then divides it again (1 in 0.25), and Glass stays guaranteed to break for the rest of the run even after the Sledgehammer is gone. Both now count the OTHER Sledgehammers (same result as the Lua for buying / selling / destroying).

Dread: SMODS calls remove_from_deck on a debuff too, so a debuffed Dread dropped its levels, regained nothing when re-enabled, and dropped them again when removed. Levels are now lost only on a real removal (from_debuff is ignored), as its text says.
Loan Shark: SMODS calls add_to_deck again when a debuffed card is re-enabled, so every debuff cycle (e.g. Crimson Heart) paid another $50. It pays only when acquired (from_debuff is ignored).
Knight: the stop_drag patch clears break_table after the first Knight it finds, so only the first Knight reset; every (non-debuffed) Knight now resets when the jokers are rearranged.

Protester read `G.hand.cards[i].ability.effect` (the i-th HAND card) while walking G.hand.highlighted, so a discarded Stone Card counted (and a normal card next to a Stone one didn't); it checks the discarded card.
Juggalo: with only editioned consumables the Lua's math.random(#{}) raises "interval is empty"; no consumable is picked then.
Pawn's description localized the rank ID ('11' -> ERROR for Jack ... Ace); it names the rank.

mods.name: Reverie
mods.description: A movie-themed expansion: Cine cards and quests that turn the next shop into a special shop (tags, packs, food jokers...).
systems: Cine cards: a consumable type that turns the next shop into a special shop (tags, packs, food jokers…)
Exchange Coupons: quests that turn into their Cine when completed
Tags sold as cards (Tag packs) and Film packs
Ticket editions on Cine cards

fixes.text: The Morsel coupon ("after getting 2 Food Jokers") counted a Food Joker again every time it came back from a debuff (Card:add_to_deck(from_debuff) re-ran the joker_added context): only getting one counts.

In a Cine shop that doesn't force the card kinds (The Unseen, Gem Heist, Adrifting with other Cines), an Uncommon / Rare Tag made its joker, was used up — and the joker was thrown away (the forced card was only returned when Adrifting was the sole Cine). The tag's joker is stocked.

Rerolling a Cine shop rolled (and threw away) one extra shop card: the lovely patch ran inside the vanilla refill loop after its first create_card_for_shop. The thrown-away joker stayed marked as used, so it could not show up again. The reroll stocks exactly the shop's slots.

Reverie / Crazy Lucky replaced the shop's vouchers while iterating the same list: with two voucher slots the second voucher was never replaced (and the first replacement was replaced again). Every voucher is replaced once.

mods.notPorted: NOT PORTED: Fool Metal Alchemist (+ coupon) needs Codex Arcanum and Radioactive (+ coupon) needs Fusion Jokers — neither is a Micatro mod, and Reverie itself skips both without them (`dependency`). The Mark Tag is commented out in the mod. The Cine collection page / tallies, Korean text, discovery alerts and the pack particles are UI of the original game.

mods.name: AutumnMoodMechanics
mods.description: Mechanics library: Oddity cards and packs, joker Stamps, card Aspects, a graveyard for destroyed cards, suit levels.
systems: A mechanics library other mods build on (Þe Autumn Circus)
Oddity cards (a consumable type with its own rarities) and Oddity packs
Stamps (a seal on Jokers) and Aspects (a second seal-like layer on playing cards)
A graveyard for destroyed cards, Bottles (a card stays on top of the deck), suit levels, unscored-card bonuses and petting

fixes.text: Legendary Oddities: the get_current_pool patch used rarity_pools[-4] (nonexistent) — the Heirloom Tag crashed instead of making a Legendary Oddity. It uses the Legendary (4) pool (oddity.js).
combine_cards' new card never got a playing_card number, so a combined card could never reach the graveyard when destroyed; it's numbered like any card added to the deck.

AMM's get_current_pool patch sends a legendary Oddity roll to rarity_pools[-4], which doesn't exist (a leftover from negative rarities) — the Heirloom Tag's "Legendary Oddity" crashed. It means the Legendary (4) pool; the pool key stays the Lua's "Oddity-4".

mods.notPorted: Skipped: api/PlusMult.lua (commented out in the mod — and with it its 2 sounds, which only it registered), the config menu (JoyousSpring / field spells / "no no_collection"), the collection pages (Micatro has no collection screen), the cross-mod lovely files (joyous_crossmod / backwards_compat / graveyard_patches / post.toml: JoyousSpring, SixSuits, AllInJest, pta_saka, Aikoyori, vallkarri, Maximus — none in Micatro) and lovely.toml's patches to mods Micatro doesn't have (Cryptid, Entropy, YGGDRASIL, SpectrumAPI, 0 ERROR, pta_saka, TOGA, Maximus, JoyousSpring, a MoreFluff Cryptid check). Its Pokermon patch (an evolving joker keeps its Stamp) needs nothing: Micatro's Pokermon evolves a joker in place (set_ability), so its seal stays.

mods.name: Þe Autumn Circus
mods.description: Welcome to Þe Autumn Circus! 70 jokers, 28 Oddities, new tarots, planets and spectrals, 9 decks, joker Stamps, card Aspects and the Gilded edition (more with More Fluff on).
systems: Uses AutumnMoodMechanics: 10 Stamps, 12 Aspects, suit-level planets, Oddities and the graveyard
The Gilded edition, two Homestuck joker rarities (Player, God Tier)
Tarots, planets, spectrals, 9 decks, 12 vouchers, a stake and blinds
Cross-mod cards with More Fluff (Rotarots, a Colour) when both are on

fixes.text: Chance: the seal is `seal_list[math.floor(roll * #seal_list)]` on a 1-based list — index 0 is nil (no seal although the ~20% seal roll hit) and the last seal of the pool (Purple) could never be chosen. It picks floor(roll * n) + 1, every seal equally.

Mischief: its "each OTHER Joker" guard compares against `chosen_joker`, an undefined global (nil), so the joker being destroyed was stamped too (a stamp, sound and animation on a dissolving card; no lasting effect, its deck effect is undone as it leaves). Only jokers still in the joker row get a stamp.

Gift from the Void: the Lua's create_playing_card(..., G.deck) already puts the new card in the deck and then G.deck:emplace(_card) puts it there AGAIN — the deck held the same card twice (drawn twice, corrupting the hand). It is emplaced once.

The C.S.I.: gated on `#G.graveyard > 1`, so a graveyard holding exactly one face card gave nothing while its text promised "+10 Chips for each face card (Currently +10)". The gate is "graveyard not empty" (the faces count already returns early at 0).

Exorcist: the same `#G.graveyard > 1` gate, yet its body handles a one-card graveyard (`if temp_gy[2]`); a lone graveyard card was never exorcised. The gate is "graveyard not empty" (its in_pool is count > 0).
Gallows Humor: text "X3 Mult if there are 15 or more cards in your graveyard", code `count > 15` (16+). It fires at 15 or more, as written.

Twisted Mind: its calculate read `context.other_card.area` before checking anything (every context without other_card — joker_main, setting_blind, the probability passes — crashed), and it waited for graveyard cards to be evaluated individually, which never happens: it did nothing. "Cards in your graveyard are scored as if they were held in your hand": after the held cards score, each graveyard card is scored as held (SMODS.score_card with cardarea G.hand, as its calculate does), once per Twisted Mind owned and not debuffed.

Opal Moonmage: its repetition branch ran for HELD cards too (index 0 in G.play), so an unscored Club played first retriggered every card held in hand. "retrigger the cards to their left and right" — only played cards.

Ruby Sunmage: the unscored-Heart scaling has no `not context.blueprint` guard (the author's other scaling jokers have it), so a Blueprint / Brainstorm copying it scaled Ruby's own counter a second time. Copies now only copy its +Mult.
the text gives "each Joker and consumable" +$2 of sell value; the Lua loops over G.jokers only. Consumables gain it too.

Void's check (`context.other_card == card` together with main_scoring) is never true in Steamodded's scoring — the card is scored before other_card is set — so the Aspect never did anything. Its text: "Score this card as if it was played and scored while it is held in hand": a held Void card is scored as a played card (SMODS.score_card with cardarea = G.play) during its held-in-hand scoring.

the voucher's text says a NEGATIVE Wheel's chance "is forced to be 1 in 4" — the Lua rolled it with the usual (Oops-boostable) probability, so Oops! All 6s chained Negative Wheels forever. A Negative Wheel rolls a plain 1 in 4. (Its other quirk — the use patch sits in the Wheel / Ectoplasm / Hex branch, so using Ectoplasm or Hex also rolled — is fixed too: only The Wheel of Fortune, as the text says.)
the lovely patch reads G.GAME.thac_undying_deck, but the Undying Deck sets G.GAME.modifiers.thac_undying_deck — so the deck never brought anything back. It reads the modifier.

the Lua lists them before checking `dependencies`, so a joker needing a mod that isn't installed was in the list and Placeholder Joker could turn into a center that doesn't exist (a crash); only jokers loaded for this run are listed.
